key_impacts: Harbor/break walls were overtopped and waves flooded the shoreline and into city streets in Ludington.
Damage reported to shoreline homes/cottages and public/boat docks.
Water intake pumps were impacted due to large water level changes; divers were at a hydroelectric plant water intake during the event.
Water level fluctuations up to 0.5 m were recorded at the Ludington harbor gauge, with reports of about 2 m fluctuations along the nearby coastline outside the harbor.
No injuries or fatalities were reported.
